      • Earnings Guidance: For Q4 2026, 32 S&P 500 companies have issued negative EPS guidance and 43 S&P 500
        companies have issued positive EPS guidance.
      • Valuation: The forward 12-month P/E ratio for the S&P 500 is 17.7. This P/E ratio is below the 5-year average
        (19.8) and below the 10-year average (19.1).


Lowest Forward 12-Month P/E Ratio For the S&P 500 in More Than 3 Years

On November 5, the forward 12-month P/E ratio for the S&P 500 was 17.7. This forward 12-month P/E ratio was based on
a closing price of 7353.73 and a forward 12-month EPS estimate of $415.82. How does this 17.7 P/E ratio compare to
historical averages? What is driving the recent decrease in the P/E ratio?

The forward 12-month P/E ratio of 17.7 on November 5 was below the 5-year average of 19.8 and below the 10-year
average of 19.1. In fact, this marked the lowest forward 12-month P/E ratio recorded bv the index since November 1, 2023
(17.5).
